method: Returned to Amsterdam Tables 4–6, B2.5 and VU’s semester-project descriptions after freezing the pair. Rebuilt the six 30 EC positions, checked prerequisites and reconsidered the best case for each UCR response against the exact current taught content.
findings: EER B2.5 minor requires 90 EC, of which at least 52 from year one, and no more than 8 outstanding concurrent EC for Amsterdam. Free and external minors need prior approval under B2.7. Research Skills starts after all year-one credits plus 26 from semester three and 20 from semester four. The supervisor must pass the proposal before the 12 EC BSc Assignment can start. The project is individual, with a scientific article and presentation. B4 assessment rules and the Amsterdam-specific table apply. The Amsterdam table does not add the separately credited Enschede societal-embedding unit. Continuous assessments carry credits within the displayed semester totals. Workshop safety under B1.2 and the first-year study-advice framework under A6.2 are separate conditions, not additional EC.

The healthcare technology project requires a functioning, controlled precision mechanism. UCR supplies anatomy and perception as well as computational robot motion, signal modelling and physical consumer prototyping. Together those courses do not provide the elasticity, precision design and device-testing sequence required to study that target direction at comparable depth. The energy test retains renewable design, actual generation and storage study, life-cycle analysis and introductory thermodynamics. Amsterdam requires the further study of thermal cycles, fluid mechanics, heat transfer and experimental design. Smart manufacturing similarly adds polymers, tribology, dynamics and shop practice that the UCR prototype and mathematical courses do not sustain. All three schedules are feasible, so the finding rests on academic fit.
The reader record preserves the 30 EC minor, 5 EC research preparation, 12 EC individual assignment and distinct Amsterdam identity, with no UCR comparison shown.
